summary: Standard BioTools Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two transactions. First, it entered a Termination, Waiver and Release Agreement with Illumina, receiving ~$30 million cash to waive the 2026 Illumina earnout (based on 2026 SomaScan net revenue) and terminate royalty and license agreements. Second, on July 28, 2026, it entered a Share and Asset Purchase Agreement with Multiplex Bio Inc. to sell its mass cytometry business. The divestiture terms (price, valuation) are not stated. The Illumina termination is a monetization of contingent earnout/royalty streams, while the Multiplex sale is an asset divestiture. Watch for closing conditions, purchase price disclosure, and regulatory approvals.
